growth_signal.value: 2023 revenue was 100M SEK (about €8.6M), a 10x increase year over year versus 2022.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved
raised.value: €100M total, including a €45M Series A extension

entry.idea: Flower manages and trades flexible energy assets, like batteries, wind farms, solar farms and EV chargers, to make renewable power more reliable for the grid.
entry.lesson: As a market shifts to many small, uneven producers, build the layer that coordinates them all, rather than owning the hardware yourself.
entry.name: Flower

growth.reason: Revenue grew tenfold in a year, a clear, well-sourced number.

market.reason: Balancing renewable energy is a growing need across the whole European power grid, and Flower is expanding into several countries.

tech.reason: Its software works across many hardware types, a real edge, but the approach could be matched by a strong team within a year or two.

entry.twist: Its software works across many different kinds of hardware from different owners, instead of managing just one type of energy asset.
entry.who_pays: Owners of energy assets like battery parks, wind farms and solar farms pay Flower to optimise and trade their power.
entry.why_now: As more wind and solar power connects to the grid, grids need smarter tools to balance supply and demand in real time.
